description: This file contains implementation for managing packing data and object lookups within a Git repository, including hash-based object locating, pack file mapping, and packlist manipulations.

methods.name: uint32_t locate_object_entry_hash(struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid,int * found)
methods.description: Locates the hash position of an object ID within the packing_data index, setting found status.

methods.name: uint32_t closest_pow2(uint32_t v)
methods.description: Calculates the closest power of two greater than or equal to the given value.

methods.name: void rehash_objects(struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Rehashes objects in the packing_data, resizing hash table based on collision count and object count.

methods.name: struct:object_entry * packlist_find(struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Finds an object in the packing list by object ID, returning a pointer if found.

methods.name: void prepare_in_pack_by_idx(struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Prepares the in_pack index mapping for quick pack lookup.

methods.name: void oe_map_new_pack(struct packing_data * pack)
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new pack to the packing_data after race conditions.

methods.name: void prepare_packing_data(struct repository * r,struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Initializes and prepares the packing data structure for a repository, optionally using full in-pack array.

methods.name: void clear_packing_data(struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Frees allocated memory of packing data.

methods.name: struct:object_entry * packlist_alloc(struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Allocates a new object entry in the pack list and updates hash structures.

methods.name: void oe_set_delta_ext(struct packing_data * pdata,struct object_entry * delta,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Sets up an object as a delta extension base, marking flags accordingly.

ctags.name: locate_object_entry_hash
ctags.signature: (struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid,int * found)

ctags.name: oe_set_delta_ext
ctags.signature: (struct packing_data * pdata,struct object_entry * delta,const struct object_id * oid)
